Visitor handles custom elements with nested content

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert

def main() -> None:
    class _TestVisitor:
        def visit_custom_element(self, ctx, tag_name, html):  # noqa: ANN001, ANN202, ARG002
            return {"type": "custom", "output": "[CUSTOM WIDGET]"}
    html = '<div><custom-widget data-value="123"><p>Widget content here</p><span>With nested elements</span></custom-widget></div>'
    result = convert(html, visitor=_TestVisitor())
    print(result.content)

main()
```
